audit_status.source_base: Hebrew/Aramaic source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Aramaic administrative decree text preserved; key chronological and royal-name variants (Darius-year; Artaxerxes) flagged for witness review; divine name rendered YHWH.

verses.restored: Then Darius the king issued a decree; a search was made in the house of records (Aramaic: beit sepheraya), where the treasures were stored in Babylon.

familiar.text: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

modern.text: Thus King Darius ordered a search of the archives stored in the treasury of Babylon.

original.text: בֵּאדַ֛יִן דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֖א שָׂ֣ם טְעֵ֑ם וּבַקַּ֣רוּ בְּבֵ֣ית סִפְרַיָּ֗א דִּ֧י גִנְזַיָּ֛א מְהַחֲתִ֥ין תַּמָּ֖ה בְּבָבֶֽל

verses.restored: And it was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a scroll; and therein was a record written thus:

familiar.text: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

modern.text: And a scroll was found in the fortress of Ecbatana, in the province of Media, with the following written on it: Memorandum:

original.text: וְהִשְׁתְּכַ֣ח בְּאַחְמְתָ֗א בְּבִֽירְתָ֛א דִּ֛י בְּמָדַ֥י מְדִינְתָּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֣ה חֲדָ֑ה וְכֵן כְּתִ֥יב בְּגַוַּ֖הּ דִּכְרוֹנָֽה

verses.restored: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus made a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be built, the place where they offer sacrifices; let its foundations be firmly laid, its height sixty cubits and its breadth sixty cubits.

familiar.text: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

modern.text: In the first year of King Cyrus, he issued a decree concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be rebuilt as a place for offering sacrifices, and let its foundations be firmly laid. It is to be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide,

original.text: בִּשְׁנַ֨ת חֲדָ֜ה לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֗א כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא֮ שָׂ֣ם טְעֵם֒ בֵּית אֱלָהָ֤א בִֽירוּשְׁלֶם֙ בַּיְתָ֣א יִתְבְּנֵ֔א אֲתַר֙ דִּֽי דָבְחִ֣ין דִּבְחִ֔ין וְאֻשּׁ֖וֹהִי מְסֽוֹבְלִ֑ין רוּמֵהּ֙ אַמִּ֣ין שִׁתִּ֔ין פְּתָיֵ֖הּ אַמִּ֥ין שִׁתִּֽין

verses.restored: With three rows of great stones and a row of new timber; and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house.

familiar.text: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king’s house:

modern.text: with three layers of cut stones and one of timbers. The costs are to be paid from the royal treasury.

original.text: נִדְבָּכִ֞ין דִּי אֶ֤בֶן גְּלָל֙ תְּלָתָ֔א וְנִדְבָּ֖ךְ דִּי אָ֣ע חֲדַ֑ת וְנִ֨פְקְתָ֔א מִן בֵּ֥ית מַלְכָּ֖א תִּתְיְהִֽב

verses.restored: Also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought again to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its place and to be set in the house of God.

familiar.text: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.

modern.text: Furthermore, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and carried to Babylon, must also be returned to the temple in Jerusalem and deposited in the house of God.

original.text: וְ֠אַף מָאנֵ֣י בֵית אֱלָהָא֮ דִּ֣י דַהֲבָ֣ה וְכַסְפָּא֒ דִּ֣י נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּ֗ר הַנְפֵּ֛ק מִן הֵיכְלָ֥א דִי בִירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם וְהֵיבֵ֣ל לְבָבֶ֑ל יַהֲתִיב֗וּן וִ֠יהָךְ לְהֵיכְלָ֤א דִי בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לְאַתְרֵ֔הּ וְתַחֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלָהָֽא

verses.restored: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites who are beyond the river, be far from there;

familiar.text: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shetharboznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

notes.title: short
notes.body: Names are Aramaic administrative titles; 'beyond the river' indicates the western Euphrates frontier.

modern.text: Therefore Darius decreed: To Tattenai governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and your associates and officials in the region: You must stay away from that place!

original.text: כְּעַ֡ן תַּ֠תְּנַי פַּחַ֨ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֜ה שְׁתַ֤ר בּוֹזְנַי֙ וּכְנָוָ֣תְה֔וֹן אֲפַרְסְכָיֵ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה רַחִיקִ֥ין הֲו֖וֹ מִן תַּמָּֽה

verses.restored: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

familiar.text: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.

modern.text: Leave this work on the house of God alone. Let the governor and elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.

original.text: שְׁבֻ֕קוּ לַעֲבִידַ֖ת בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ פַּחַ֤ת יְהוּדָיֵא֙ וּלְשָׂבֵ֣י יְהוּדָיֵ֔א בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ יִבְנ֥וֹן עַל אַתְרֵֽהּ

verses.restored: Moreover I decree that what you shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, let expenses be given to these men promptly, that they be not hindered.

familiar.text: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

modern.text: I hereby decree what you must do for these elders of the Jews who are rebuilding this house of God: The cost is to be paid in full to these men from the royal treasury out of the taxes of the provinces west of the Euphrates, so that the work will not be hindered.

original.text: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ לְמָ֣א דִֽי תַֽעַבְד֗וּן עִם שָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ אִלֵּ֔ךְ לְמִבְנֵ֖א בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣א דֵ֑ךְ וּמִנִּכְסֵ֣י מַלְכָּ֗א דִּ֚י מִדַּת֙ עֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה אָסְפַּ֗רְנָא נִפְקְתָ֛א תֶּהֱוֵ֧א מִֽתְיַהֲבָ֛א לְגֻבְרַיָּ֥א אִלֵּ֖ךְ דִּי לָ֥א לְבַטָּלָֽא

verses.restored: And what they need—young bullocks, rams, lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil—according to the appointment of the priests at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail.

familiar.text: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

modern.text: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and oil, as requested by the priests in Jerusalem—must be given to them daily without fail.

original.text: וּמָ֣ה חַשְׁחָ֡ן וּבְנֵ֣י תוֹרִ֣ין וְדִכְרִ֣ין וְאִמְּרִ֣ין לַעֲלָוָ֣ן לֶאֱלָ֪הּ שְׁמַיָּ֟א חִנְטִ֞ין מְלַ֣ח חֲמַ֣ר וּמְשַׁ֗ח כְּמֵאמַ֨ר כָּהֲנַיָּ֤א דִי בִירֽוּשְׁלֶם֙ לֶהֱוֵ֨א מִתְיְהֵ֥ב לְהֹ֛ם י֥וֹם בְּי֖וֹם דִּי לָ֥א שָׁלֽוּ

verses.restored: That they may offer sweet savour sacrifices unto the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and of his sons.

familiar.text: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

modern.text: Then they will be able to offer sacrifices of a sweet aroma to the God of heaven and to pray for the lives of the king and his sons.

original.text: דִּֽי לֶהֱוֺ֧ן מְהַקְרְבִ֛ין נִיחוֹחִ֖ין לֶאֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א וּמְצַלַּ֕יִן לְחַיֵּ֥י מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי

verses.restored: Also I have made a decree: whoever shall alter this word, timber shall be pulled down from his house; and being set up, he shall be hanged thereon, and his house shall be made a dunghill for this.

familiar.text: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

modern.text: I also decree that if any man interferes with this directive, a beam is to be torn from his house and raised up, and he is to be impaled on it. And his own house shall be made a pile of rubble for this offense.

original.text: וּמִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל אֱנָ֗שׁ דִּ֤י יְהַשְׁנֵא֙ פִּתְגָמָ֣א דְנָ֔ה יִתְנְסַ֥ח אָע֙ מִן בַּיְתֵ֔הּ וּזְקִ֖יף יִתְמְחֵ֣א עֲלֹ֑הִי וּבַיְתֵ֛הּ נְוָל֥וּ יִתְעֲבֵ֖ד עַל דְּנָֽה

verses.restored: And the God who caused His name to dwell there, destroy all kings and peoples that shall put forth hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

familiar.text: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

modern.text: May God, who has caused His Name to dwell there, overthrow any king or people who lifts a hand to alter this decree or to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the decree. Let it be carried out with diligence. The Temple Completed

original.text: וֵֽאלָהָ֞א דִּ֣י שַׁכִּ֧ן שְׁמֵ֣הּ תַּמָּ֗ה יְמַגַּ֞ר כָּל מֶ֤לֶךְ וְעַם֙ דִּ֣י יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְדֵ֗הּ לְהַשְׁנָיָ֛ה לְחַבָּלָ֛ה בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥א דֵ֖ךְ דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם אֲנָ֤ה דָרְיָ֨וֶשׁ֙ שָׂ֣מֶת טְעֵ֔ם אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד

verses.restored: Then Tatnai, governor on this side of the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, did speedily.

familiar.text: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shetharboznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

modern.text: In response, Tattenai the governor of the region west of the Euphrates, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates diligently carried out what King Darius had decreed.

original.text: אֱ֠דַיִן תַּתְּנַ֞י פַּחַ֧ת עֲבַֽר נַהֲרָ֛ה שְׁתַ֥ר בּוֹזְנַ֖י וּכְנָוָתְה֑וֹן לָקֳבֵ֗ל דִּֽי שְׁלַ֞ח דָּרְיָ֧וֶשׁ מַלְכָּ֛א כְּנֵ֖מָא אָסְפַּ֥רְנָא עֲבַֽדוּ

verses.restored: And the elders of the Jews built, and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo; and they built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel and according to the commandment of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

familiar.text: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

notes.title: short
notes.body: The mention of Artaxerxes alongside Cyrus and Darius likely reflects later editorial layering; preserved here as in the Aramaic witness.

modern.text: So the Jewish elders built and prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They finished building according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

original.text: וְשָׂבֵ֤י יְהוּדָיֵא֙ בָּנַ֣יִן וּמַצְלְחִ֔ין בִּנְבוּאַת֙ חַגַּ֣י נביאה וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה בַּר עִדּ֑וֹא וּבְנ֣וֹ וְשַׁכְלִ֗לוּ מִן טַ֨עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִטְּעֵם֙ כּ֣וֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָ֔וֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֖שְׂתְּא מֶ֥לֶךְ פָּרָֽס

verses.restored: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar; (the Aramaic register reads: in the second year of the reign of Darius the king) — preserved here as the source states.

familiar.text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Source reads 'second year' (Aramaic) for completion; KJV tradition records 'sixth year' — both witnesses noted.

modern.text: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius. Dedication of the Temple

original.text: וְשֵׁיצִיא֙ בַּיְתָ֣ה דְנָ֔ה עַ֛ד י֥וֹם תְּלָתָ֖ה לִירַ֣ח אֲדָ֑ר דִּי הִ֣יא שְׁנַת שֵׁ֔ת לְמַלְכ֖וּת דָּרְיָ֥וֶשׁ מַלְכָּֽא

verses.restored: And the children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

familiar.text: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

modern.text: Then the people of Israel—the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the exiles—celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

original.text: וַעֲבַ֣דוּ בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּ֨א וְלֵוָיֵ֜א וּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּנֵי גָלוּתָ֗א חֲנֻכַּ֛ת בֵּית אֱלָהָ֥א דְנָ֖ה בְּחֶדְוָֽה

verses.restored: And they offered at the dedication of this house of God a hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel twelve he-goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

familiar.text: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

modern.text: For the dedication of the house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and a sin offering for all Israel of twelve male goats, one for each tribe of Israel.

original.text: וְהַקְרִ֗בוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת֮ בֵּית אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָה֒ תּוֹרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה דִּכְרִ֣ין מָאתַ֔יִן אִמְּרִ֖ין אַרְבַּ֣ע מְאָ֑ה וּצְפִירֵ֨י עִזִּ֜ין לחטיא עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ תְּרֵֽי עֲשַׂ֔ר לְמִנְיָ֖ן שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of the God which is at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.

familiar.text: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

modern.text: They also appointed the priests by their divisions and the Levites by their groups to the service of God in Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses. The Returned Exiles Keep the Passover

original.text: וַהֲקִ֨ימוּ כָהֲנַיָּ֜א בִּפְלֻגָּתְה֗וֹן וְלֵוָיֵא֙ בְּמַחְלְקָ֣תְה֔וֹן עַל עֲבִידַ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖א דִּ֣י בִירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם כִּכְתָ֖ב סְפַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: And the children of the captivity kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

familiar.text: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.

modern.text: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles kept the Passover.

original.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵי הַגּוֹלָ֖ה אֶת הַפָּ֑סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן

verses.restored: For the priests and the Levites were purified together; all of them were pure, and they killed the Passover for all the children of the captivity and for their brethren the priests and for themselves.

familiar.text: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

modern.text: All the priests and Levites had purified themselves and were ceremonially clean. And the Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their priestly brothers, and for themselves.

original.text: כִּ֣י הִֽטַּהֲר֞וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם כְּאֶחָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֣ם טְהוֹרִ֑ים וַיִּשְׁחֲט֤וּ הַפֶּ֨סַח֙ לְכָל בְּנֵ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֥ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְלָהֶֽם

verses.restored: And the children of Israel who had come again out of captivity, and all who had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the peoples of the land, to seek YHWH God of Israel, ate

familiar.text: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,

modern.text: The Israelites who had returned from exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the uncleanness of the peoples of the land to seek the LORD, the God of Israel.

original.text: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַשָּׁבִים֙ מֵֽהַגּוֹלָ֔ה וְכֹ֗ל הַנִּבְדָּ֛ל מִטֻּמְאַ֥ת גּוֹיֵֽ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם לִדְרֹ֕שׁ לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy; for YHWH had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

familiar.text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Text reads 'king of Assyria' (Aramaic); its relation to Persian royal favor is a textual peculiarity requiring witness comparison.

modern.text: For seven days they kept the Feast of Unleavened Bread with joy, because the LORD had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them to strengthen their hands in the work on the house of the God of Israel.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֧וּ חַג מַצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה כִּ֣י שִׂמְּחָ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְֽהֵסֵ֞ב לֵ֤ב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לְחַזֵּ֣ק יְדֵיהֶ֔ם בִּמְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

translation_notes: Base text is Aramaic (Ezra 4:6–6:18 area). Rendered literally where the Aramaic prescribes royal formulae and ritual terms; YHWH used for divine name.
Chronological discrepancy: local Aramaic text reads 'second year' for completion (v15) vs. KJV 'sixth year' — preserved as variant.
Personal/place names left transliterated (Tatnai, Shetharboznai, Achmetha) to retain administrative flavour.
safety_note: Contains imperial, coercive, and cultic material; not for use to justify present-day targeting or demeaning groups.
